snippets.INSTRUCTIONS:
Your Panda wants to be the best ice cream seller on Panfu!
You have to prepare delicious ice cream in cones for your customers. If you make a mistake, you have to throw the cone away, so concentrate and be careful! When you've made it past the goal for the round, then you'll become the greatest ice cream seller of all time!
snippets.INSTRUCTIONS2:
Make the ice cream just how the customer wants it.
Click on the cone to fill it with ice cream. Click on the bowl with the dough to make the ice cream cone.
snippets.INSTRUCTIONS3:
Click on the bowl of ice cream to make scoops.
Wait until the cones are ready, and then click them to put them on the table. Hurry up or else they'll burn!
snippets.INSTRUCTIONS4: You can put different kinds of toppings, sauces and fruit on your ice cream. Just click on the tube and let it all squeeze out! When the ice cream is ready, you can serve it to your customer.
